    | Field | Value |

    ### Encoding

    | Field | Value |
    | --- | --- |
    | `position` | atom coordinates normalized into scene space |
    | `color` | element-style atom colors from the preparation bundle |
    | `size` | atom radii scaled for sphere impostors |
